I replied to Hollis in our DM and noted Caspian Halvorsen as his escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Nettle rollout. I didn't take any other action.

I also told him two things:
- I'll keep this in our DM and won't bring it up in other conversations or channels.
- I can't count on a private memory for each person, so that DM message is the record I'll look it up from later. If his team needs to know, he should post it in the Nettle or Central channel himself.
